_comment: Config for the headroom folder extension. Missing or broken file -> built-in defaults, same behavior.
Provider upstreams come straight from ../../models.json (pi's own manifest) - no copies here.
This map only carries per-provider overrides: enabled (default: true, except built-in defaults),
baseUrl override, shim override (default: automatic - providers whose chat path does not end in /v1
route through the in-process path shim at 127.0.0.1:8790, falling back to the next five
ports when busy, so several pi sessions can run side by side).
freetoken: disabled - loopback upstream rejected by Headroom's SSRF guard; no compression value.
nube: disabled - upstream resets proxied requests (E2E 2026-09-26).
zai-paas / zai-paasv2: enabled, auto-shimmed (real path /api/coding/paas/v4/chat/completions).
extraEnv feeds the proxy process. SSL_CERT_FILE et al. point at the exported Windows root bundle
(~/.headroom/win-ca-bundle.pem) because this machine TLS-intercepts (plan D13).
rateLimit raises headroom's own token bucket (defaults 60 rpm / 100000 tpm). A single pi turn
carries 80K-120K tokens, so the 100K/min default makes headroom answer 429 itself without
contacting any provider; pi reads that as provider rate-limiting and walks the whole tier.
Set false to restore headroom's defaults, or { rpm, tpm } to pick your own. Applies only to a
proxy this extension spawns: an already-running (adopted) proxy keeps its old limits.
modelLimits: the extension builds HEADROOM_MODEL_LIMITS from every models.json contextWindow
(48 models) so headroom stops guessing 128,000 for unknown models. Same id on two providers
with different windows takes the minimum. Set false to restore headroom's defaults, or an
explicit { "model": tokens } map to override individual entries.
